Turn heads with this adorable matching black and white striped sweater set, perfect for mother-daughter duo outfits. The bold horizontal stripes create a chic and timeless look, while the oversized sleeves and cuff details add a stylish touch. Crafted from soft, cozy fabric, these sweaters are ideal for cooler weather, ensuring both comfort and fashion. Perfect for casual outings, family photos, or coffee dates, this sweater set is a must-have for those seeking a trendy yet relaxed vibe. Pair them with leggings or jeans for an effortlessly fashionable look.

  • Bold black and white horizontal stripes for a trendy look
  • Loose, comfortable fit for casual outings and relaxed days
  • Features oversized sleeves with cuff detailing
  • Perfect for autumn and winter weather
  • Made from soft, high-quality knitted fabric
  • Easy to pair with leggings, boots, or jeans
